top_signals.title: Fed Officials Debate Pace of Rate Hikes as Williams Urges Measured Action
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams said the central bank still has work to do to bring inflation back to its 2% goal, but dismissed the suggestion the Fed needs to consider an outsized rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
top_signals.summary: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
